idea-plugin.name: Lit Template Binding Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the lit-html binding positions auto-escaping does not cover, before the component ships

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Lit Template Binding Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/lit-binding-xss-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/lit-binding-xss-audit

action.text: Lit Template Binding Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Lit Template Binding Audit on the file in the editor
